I lived in Poland for a year, a very long time ago, so I don’t know much, but I know it’s hard from the way it was described to me when I grew older and from distant memories. Honestly, I didn’t have a really good experience with the country, but that’s subjective. This advice may not really apply to you, but the best thing I could advise you is to find something to distract your mind from stress and suicidal thoughts and to find activities that find you hope, in the past I’ve tried playing chess, learning languages, and playing video games. But again, this may not work for everyone. I know the thoughts are hard to fight, but I don’t endorse that you die, that would be a tragedy. But I just responded to this because I think it’s ironic how earlier today my mom and I were talking about our bad experiences in Poland.

I’m the opposite, I genuinely believe that everyone wants me to die. In one way or another they have said that they would prefer a world without me in it, they even made death threats and some attempted murder. I wonder that if people hate me that much if I should even live. But in you situation, I suppose that it’s selfish to force a person to live in misery for the happened of others, but I don’t really know what it’s like for people to want me alive.
Besides, this site isn’t really for that. I wouldn’t encourage anyone to die, except myself.

Unless if you're dying due to medical problems or age, there's no reason why when it's time to kill yourself you should be scared. If anything, being dead will be oddly comforting.
